prompt: Our API client is supposed to cache responses for 60 seconds, but the metrics show a cache miss and a new network request for nearly every call, even when the same URL is requested twice within a second. Find the fault. Answer with the file and the function that contain it, and one sentence on why. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: lib/ttl.js, isFresh: it compares elapsed milliseconds with a ttl in seconds, so entries go stale after 60 ms; it should compare with ttl * 1000.
